svg.title: Variant-effect map: Synthetic 20-codon target
svg.desc: Variant-effect map of Synthetic 20-codon target: 20 positions by 21 substitutions (the 20 amino acids and stop), 419 designed. 193 scored, 5 scored with low confidence, 2 filtered, 219 missing. Positions least tolerant of substitution (lowest median score): L15 -1.61, V11 -1.04, S2 -0.90, G4 -0.89, G20 -0.86. Most tolerant: M1 0.04, P13 -0.03, V16 -0.04, L18 -0.07, I14 -0.18. Colors run from -2.62 to 2.62, centered on the wild type (0.00).
